_readme: Frozen coverage-family conformance contract. README.md is normative; this file is the referee.

arithmetic.dropped_billing: sum(quantity) over `dropped` rows whose durability_class is DURABILITY_CLASS_BILLING_GRADE, any reason (dropped_by_tenant_day / mv_tvo_session predicate: dropped_durability_class = 'billing_grade')
arithmetic.coverage: observed_ms / (observed_ms + bypass_ms + disabled_ms); 0 when the denominator is 0
arithmetic.coverage_lower: coverage * (1 - dropped_billing / (dropped_billing + events_billing_ingested)); the shed term is 0 when its denominator is 0

cases.name: zero_loss_point_band
cases._why: No Dropped rows at all: the shed term is 0/(0+ingested) = 0 and the band collapses to the point (test_band_arithmetic's numbers).

cases.name: diagnostic_shed_does_not_narrow
cases._why: A DIAGNOSTIC spool shed (NFR-OPERABILITY-001's row) folds to dropped_billing = 0: the predicate is durability_class = billing_grade, so the band is still the point. Same surface and ingested count as the next case — only the class differs.

cases.name: billing_grade_loss_narrows_only_the_lower_edge
cases._why: The same 50 as a BILLING_GRADE CRC loss: coverage is unchanged (the upper edge never moves on a drop), the lower edge is coverage × (1 − 50/1000) (test_shed_narrows_only_the_lower_edge's numbers).

cases.name: mixed_rows_fold_by_class_not_reason
cases._why: Five rows, three classes, five reasons: billing_grade quantities SUM across reasons (1 + 2), diagnostic rows and the UNSPECIFIED zero value contribute nothing. Shed = 3/(3+9).

cases.name: spool_shed_reaches_the_wire
cases._why: The exact row go/mark1d/cmd/wiring_test.go TestSpoolShedReachesTheWire puts on the wire — 32 HUMAN prompts under a 1 KiB cap shed 27 TaskOpen + 27 Turn records (README derives it) — and the day's rollup as that daemon's day would read: no CoverageTransition, no billing-grade event landed. Surface stipulated as a full observed day so the arithmetic is visible; ingested is 0 so the shed denominator is 0/0.
